---
name: Plugin proposal
about: Propose a new DSA plugin, tool package, or integration
labels: enhancement
---

## Plugin idea

What capability should the plugin add?

## User workflow

Describe the user-facing workflow and why this belongs in a plugin rather than core.

## Proposed tools

List the tool names and their inputs/outputs at a high level.

## Evidence contract

For each analytical tool, describe what evidence should be emitted and what dataset / parameters must be recorded for auditability.

## Reproducibility

What dependencies, versions, seeds, external services, or model settings must be captured so a run can be reproduced?

## Safety / permissions

Does the plugin need filesystem, network, credentials, subprocess, database, or write access? Explain the minimum permission set.

## Testing plan

How should the plugin be tested?

- [ ] unit tests
- [ ] integration test
- [ ] benchmark task
- [ ] case study
- [ ] offline/stub behavior

## References

Links to APIs, libraries, papers, prior art, or example datasets.
